doc: TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE §12.1/§12.8 — the Chapter-3 mini-game find „Das Relaispult“ (owner minigames_r7_relay): Konrad keeps the commission's interpretation desk for a few minutes of the session (scenes/ui/minigames/RelayDesk.tscn). Hotspot exp_relay_desk in assets/environments/veltrava_hall/explore_hotspots.json, interactable Find_RelayDesk (scripts/ui/minigames/relay_spot.gd: open after c3b_arrival until c3b_inspect_booth, and in a memory) and the desk prop in scenes/levels/L_C3_Hall.tscn. Texts: data/locale/de_minigames_r7_relay.json (Konrad's voice). The find links the existing real-history card on simultaneous interpreting at Nuremberg (shown once, whichever find comes first).
